title: Ensure 'Enable App Installer' is set to 'Disabled'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\Windows Components\Desktop App Installer\Enable App Installer to 'Disabled'
reason: Windows Package Manager (winget) can be used to discover, install, upgrade, remove and configure applications. Users should not have access to these types of development tools.

title: Ensure 'Enable App Installer Experimental Features' is set to 'Disabled'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\Windows Components\Desktop App Installer\Enable App Installer Experimental Features to 'Disabled'
reason: Users should not have access to experimental features for the Windows Package Manager.

title: Ensure 'Enable App Installer Hash Override' is set to 'Disabled'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\Windows Components\Desktop App Installer\Enable App Installer Hash Override to 'Disabled'
reason: Users should not have the ability to override SHA256 security validation.

title: Ensure 'Enable App Installer Local Archive Malware Scan Override' is set to 'Disabled'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\Windows Components\Desktop App Installer\Enable App Installer Local Archive Malware Scan Override to 'Disabled'
reason: Users should not have the ability to override malware scans.

title: Ensure 'Enable App Installer ms-appinstaller protocol' is set to 'Disabled'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\Windows Components\Desktop App Installer\Enable App Installer ms-appinstaller protocol to 'Disabled'
reason: If an unknown or malicious link is clicked, malicious software could be installed on the system.

title: Ensure 'Enable App Installer Microsoft Store Source Certificate Validation Bypass' is set to 'Disabled'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\Windows Components\Desktop App Installer\Enable App Installer Microsoft Store Source Certificate Validation Bypass to 'Disabled'
reason: It is important to validate that the Microsoft Store source is not spoofed.

title: Ensure 'Enable Windows Package Manager command line interfaces' is set to 'Disabled'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\Windows Components\Desktop App Installer\Enable Windows Package Manager command line interfaces to 'Disabled'
reason: Users should not have access to these types of development tools.
